title: LLaTSA: Large Language Model-Aligned General-Purpose Transient Stability Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.14374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic trajectory prediction has become an important paradigm for data-driven transient stability analysis (TSA), yet most existing predictors remain system-specific and require substantial retraining when network configurations, generation mixes, or state-variable sets change. Uni-TSA introduced a general-purpose TSA framework that combines channel-independent modeling with a pretrained large language model (LLM) predictor. Nevertheless, its application to heterogeneous systems is limited by ambiguity in short observations, a mismatch between numerical trajectories and LLM embeddings, neglected coupling among state variables, and the high inference cost of dense backbones. This paper proposes LLaTSA, an LLM-aligned framework for general-purpose trajectory-based TSA. translated_title: LLaTSA：与大语言模型对齐的通用暂态稳定分析
translated_abstract: 动态轨迹预测已成为数据驱动的暂态稳定分析（TSA）的重要范式，然而现有的大多数预测器仍然是针对特定系统的，当网络结构、发电组合或状态变量集合发生变化时，需要进行大量的重新训练。Uni-TSA 提出了一个通用的 TSA 框架，将通道独立建模与预训练大语言模型（LLM）预测器相结合。然而，其在异构系统中的应用受到以下因素的限制：短时观测中的模糊性、数值轨迹与 LLM 嵌入之间的失配、对状态变量之间耦合关系的忽视，以及密集骨干网络的高推理成本。本文提出了 LLaTSA，一个与大语言模型对齐的、基于轨迹的通用暂态稳定分析框架。LLaTSA 首先通过结构化文本前缀融合运行条件、扰动属性和状态变量身份信息，然后对归一化的时序（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出 LLaTSA 框架，通过结构化文本前缀融合运行条件、扰动属性与状态变量身份，并将归一化轨迹与大语言模型嵌入对齐，从而解决通用暂态稳定分析中短观测模糊、数值-嵌入失配、状态变量耦合被忽视以及推理成本高等问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLaTSA, an LLM-aligned framework for general-purpose trajectory-based transient stability analysis that addresses short-observation ambiguity, trajectory-embedding mismatch, neglected state-variable coupling, and high inference costs through structured textual prefixes and temporal alignment.
